description:
Happy makes CBT journaling easier to return to. Work with anxious thoughts through short guided journeys, practical exercises, and private reflection.

BUILD PRACTICAL CBT SKILLS
• Notice unhelpful thought patterns and practice reframing them.
• Use guided tools for moments of stress, worry, or overthinking.
• Take small steps with short lessons that fit into a busy day.

REFLECT YOUR WAY
• Write a private journal entry when you want space to think.
• Record a voice reflection when typing feels like too much.
• Return to the exercises and tools that help you most.

NOTICE YOUR PATTERNS
• Track your practice and reflections over time.
• See personal insights as you build a more consistent habit.

BUILD A GENTLE HABIT
Follow your journey, celebrate small wins, and keep moving at your own pace.

Happy is an educational wellness tool and is not a substitute for professional care.
